introduction: The destination is now beyond a corner. Read the corridor first: decide where movement ends and the change of direction begins.
explanation: turnLeft(); rotates Karel 90 degrees counterclockwise without moving it. Facing east, a left turn points north. Walls block movement, so commands must follow the corridor in the right order.
objective: Follow the corridor from (1, 1) to the beeper at (5, 4). Turn left at (5, 1), finish facing north, and leave the beeper on the ground.
instruction: Use move(); and turnLeft(); to navigate the lower corridor and then the right-hand corridor. Write the complete route inside main.
hints: Follow the lower edge to avenue 5 before turning. The north-facing wall prevents an earlier turn.
The corner is (5, 1). turnLeft(); changes the direction there but does not advance to the next square.
The route has four forward steps, one left turn, then three forward steps.

illustration.alt: Before: Karel stands on a square facing east. After turnLeft(); it stands on the same square facing north. A left turn changes direction by 90 degrees.
illustration.caption: A left turn changes the direction, not the position.

title: Around the corner
